items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: Cheek used to go to that Blit Affair whatever you have before he died.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, they had the Independent Band, which was Isidore Fritz. George Lewis has told me about that. Yeah, that's right. Isidore Fritz and Clarence. Yeah, the Clarence. Some Clarence too, but they had the Independent Band. And you remember anybody else in the Independent Band? In the Band? Like the Trumon Flair from over there. Oh, let me see now. Fat fella, big fat fella.
Cheek used to go to that Blit Affair whatever you have before he died. Dan Mooney. Yeah, Dan Mooney.
Yeah, Dan Mooney. Yeah, Dan Mooney. They had a trumpet player by the name of Leonard Parker.
